system.name: THC Living Plant Atlas
system.purpose: A clickable Cannabis plant learning system connecting 3D anatomy, sixteen plant-science systems, physiology, reproductive biology, genetics, diagnostics, measurements, evidence, visuals, and linked terpene chemistry.
system.coreRule: A symptom is evidence, not proof. Observation must be separated from diagnosis and interpreted with plant stage, environment, root-zone data, pest inspection, and recent changes.
system.architecture: V4 canonical architecture: 16 science systems plus 32 inspectable semantic anatomy structures. /terpene-atlas/ is the connected chemistry explorer.

sections.label: Leaves
sections.summary: Leaf anatomy, photosynthesis, stomata, transpiration, chlorosis, necrosis, leaf curl, nutrient clues, pest damage, and environmental stress.

sections.label: Root System
sections.summary: Roots, root hairs, rhizosphere, oxygen, water uptake, nutrient uptake, media interaction, dryback, and root disorders.

sections.label: Nodes & Branching
sections.summary: Nodes, internodes, axillary buds, branch formation, apical dominance, topping, FIM, LST, mainlining, and SCROG.

sections.label: Seed & Germination
sections.summary: Seed anatomy, viability, imbibition, radicle emergence, cotyledons, seedling transition, storage, and early failure points.

sections.label: Stem & Vascular System
sections.summary: Stem support, xylem, phloem, transport, internodal spacing, stem elongation, damage response, and training response.

sections.label: Flowers
sections.summary: Flower initiation, bracts, pistils, stigmas, bud development, resin, pollination, maturation, harvest timing, and mold risk.

sections.label: Trichomes & Resin
sections.summary: Trichome types, resin glands, maturity cues, microscope inspection, and harvest interpretation.

sections.label: Sex, Pollen & Seeds
sections.summary: Female flowers, male flowers, hermaphroditism, pollen sacs, pollination, fertilization, seed formation, and seed maturity.

sections.label: Environment Overlay
sections.summary: Whole-plant overlay for light, temperature, humidity, VPD, airflow, water, nutrients, pH, EC, CO2, and their interactions.

sections.label: Diagnostic Overlay
sections.summary: Symptom-location system for yellowing, browning, spots, curling, wilting, burnt tips, stunting, pest signs, mold signs, and root-zone clues.

sections.label: Photosynthesis & Carbon
sections.summary: Light capture, carbon dioxide diffusion, biochemical carbon fixation, carbohydrate production, source-sink allocation, and the environmental limits on carbon gain.

sections.label: Water Relations & Transpiration
sections.summary: Water potential, root-to-shoot transport, xylem tension, turgor, stomatal conductance, transpiration, hydraulic resistance, and recovery.

sections.label: Mineral Nutrition & Ion Transport
sections.summary: Essential elements, ion uptake, pH and EC context, nutrient mobility, vascular transport, biochemical roles, and evidence-based symptom interpretation.

sections.label: Genotype, Phenotype & Variation
sections.summary: Genotype, phenotype, alleles, segregation, heritability, environmental interaction, developmental effects, and repeatable trait documentation.

sections.label: Hormones & Plant Signaling
sections.summary: Auxin, cytokinin, gibberellin, ABA, ethylene, jasmonate and interacting signaling networks controlling growth, water response, defense and development.

sections.label: Stress, Defense & Acclimation
sections.summary: Heat, cold, drought, salinity, excess light, wounding, herbivory, pathogens, oxidative stress, acclimation, damage, and recovery.

pages.title: Leaf Anatomy

pages.title: Photosynthesis
pages.purpose: Connect light, carbon dioxide, water status, chlorophyll, sugars, and plant growth.

pages.title: Stomata
pages.purpose: Explain pores, guard cells, CO2 entry, water vapor exit, VPD, and transpiration.

pages.purpose: Show water movement from root zone through xylem and out of leaves.

pages.title: Chlorosis

pages.title: Leaf Curl
pages.purpose: Distinguish tacoing, canoeing, clawing, drooping, twisting, and cupping.

pages.title: Nutrient Symptoms on Leaves
pages.purpose: Interpret nutrient-like leaf symptoms with pH, EC, feed history, roots, and environment.

pages.title: Pest Damage on Leaves
pages.purpose: Recognize stippling, webbing, eggs, frass, trails, silvering, chewing, and distorted growth.

pages.title: Environmental Stress on Leaves
pages.purpose: Connect leaf posture, color, texture, growth rate, and damage location to environment.
